output.title: New certificate timestamp metrics reach the enabled ServiceMonitor scrape
output.content: v1.18.0 adds the metrics certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds. The environment sets prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled and uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate resources, so these new series will plausibly be scraped for those Certificates. Inspect whether your dashboards or alerts should adopt them and whether the added series matter for your monitoring.
